summary: Vista Credit Strategic Lending Corp. filed an 8-K reporting two items: (1) as of April 1, 2026, it sold 170,417.733 shares of Class I common stock for total consideration of $3,287,900 under subscription agreements, relying on Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S exemptions; and (2) disclosed an estimated NAV per share of $19.29 as of March 31, 2026. The share sale is a routine capital-raising activity, and the NAV disclosure is standard for a BDC. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation. The filing is a routine current report with no event triggering a special-situation classification.
